Citation

The MAML provides two file reference modes: import and include. The relative path and absolute path are supported.

Import

Uses the template defined in the target file. For example, a template named item is defined in the item.maml file.

<!-- item.maml -->
<template name="item">
  <text>{{text}}</text>
</template>

If item.maml is referenced in index.maml, the item template can be used.

<import src="item.maml"/>
<template is="item" data="{{text: 'forbar'}}"/>

Scope of import

Import has the concept of scope. That is, only the template defined in the target file is imported, but not the template imported in the target file.

For example, C imports B and B imports A. In C, the template defined by B can be used. In B, the template defined by A can be used. In C, however, the template defined by A cannot be used.

Include

Imports the entire code of the target file except
